bull.b: A very high recurring revenue mix increases predictability of cash flows and supports durable ARR-based growth. bull.t: Improving cash generation and free cash flow

bear.t: Execution risk from rapid hiring and scaling
bear.b: Aggressive hiring and rapid scaling increase execution risk: slower hires, onboarding delays, or inefficient ramping raise costs and could delay product delivery or constrain sales. These operational risks can durably impact margins and growth consistency over the medium term.
